articleTitle: Physiological Responses of Pilots' Different Turning Behavior Based on a Flight Simulator and fNIRS
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Pilots' behavior directly affects aviation safety. Exploring pilots' behavior can help to decode, simulate, and predict pilots' behavioral decisions. To examine the relationship between pilots' behavior and brain activity, this study used a flight simulator for the experiment and noninvasive functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) for measurement and analyzed the change of oxyhemoglobin concentration in 25 pilot cadets with different turning behavior. The difference analysis between left-turning and right-turning was carried out based on this database. Results suggest that pilots' different turning behavior is related to the frontopolar area. The results of this study will contribute to helping people better understand the neuroscience mechanism of pilots ‘ behavior, and provide physiological reference values for improving pilots' behavior training.

articleTitle: Evaluation for Trainee Pilot Workload Management Competency During Approach Phase Based on Flight Training Data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: With the implementation of furthering the flight training reform, competency-based training has drawn much attention for the initial flight training in aviation schools. The competencies assessment is the key to conduct the competency-based training program which is originated from the evidence-based training. The workload management (WLM) competency of pilots, which belongs to the non-technical competency, plays an important role to the flight safety. At present, most methods to evaluate the workload management competency are usually carried out through the questionnaire afterward or subjective score from the instructor's observation. However, a variety of information from the flight record data which objectively represent the flight operation behaviors has not been fully exploited. In this paper, the assessment approach for the WLM was developed based on the flight training data. Consider the correlation and redundancy of the high-dimension temporal data, the principal component analysis (PCA) was adopted to deal with the dimension reduction and feature extraction firstly. Then, the processed flight record data and the instructor score were utilized to conduct the supervised learning with the deep neural network (DNN). The case study for the approach phase WLM evaluation of trainee pilots was given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, and the results show the differences between the prediction score through the WLM evaluation and the actual score from instructors are fairly close, which proved the feasibility and efficiency of the proposed method for the WLM evaluation.

articleTitle: Ontology-based Recommender System with Descriptive Analytics in e-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: The amount of information and users has been increasing at a remarkable rate in recent years. This is where the recommender system comes in, recommender system is a system that generates a list of recommended products for the user. Recommender system has outshined as one of the important features in an e-Commerce portal. Several recommender techniques have been proposed, yet, problems such as cold-start item problem, cold-start user problem and data sparsity problem still existed. The expected outcomes of this paper are an ontology-based recommender system, combining the collaborative and content-based filtering approaches. In addition, the recommender system also generates recommendations by considering user preferences based on social network association. The experimental evaluation indicated that the proposed approach works more efficiently and effectively improves the recommendation.

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Teaching Assessment Driven by Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: With the continuous development of the world epidemic, online and offline mixed teaching has become the main way of higher education teaching. Combining the assessment of students' performance in mixed teaching with big data will make the assessment and evaluation of students' performance more quantitative and scientific. Based on the mixed teaching mode of ̋MOOC + SPOC + flipped classroom + enterprise practice”, this paper puts forward the whole process quantitative evaluation path of student achievement under the empowerment of big data, which is ;front-line course data + flipped classroom data in class + enterprise practice data integration after class”.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Lateral Safety Distance of between UAVs in Hybrid Operation Mode Based on CNS Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Nowadays, the application of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) is more and more extensive, and the demand for airspace resources is growing. UAV urgently needs to share non isolated airspace resources with UAV. In order to accelerate the integration of UAV into the national airspace system and promote the development of aviation industry, this paper studies the lateral safety distance under the mixed operation mode of Between UAVs. Starting from the communication navigation surveillance (CNS) performance, this paper analyzes the impact of CNS on the collision probability of Between UAVs during mixed operation. Combined with the event collision risk model, a new collision risk model based on CNS performance is deduced according to the UAVs operation characteristics and the target safety level (TSL) specified by the Civil Aviation administration. After that, the simulation experiment is carried out by MATLAB, and the calculation is carried out by substituting an aircraft example. According to the calculation results, the influence of CNS performance on the lateral safety distance of Between UAVs hybrid operation is analyzed.

articleTitle: Application of Gas Photoacoustic Spectroscopy Optical Detection Technology to SO2F2 Gas Concentration Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: In this paper, the influence of the SO2F2 on the spectral absorption capacity under the background of the SF6 macro-molecular gas and the influence of the temperature and pressure on spectral absorption characteristics of the measured gas are studied. Through the comprehensive comparative study of different spectral analysis technologies, the best technology is selected for gas detection. Select the low adsorption material suitable for SO2F2 gas optical absorption cell, study the anti-interference characteristics of the optical absorption cell by optically designing the technical scheme of long optical path and small volume gas detection optical absorption cell, and study the mid infrared laser driving, small signal detection demodulation and concentration inversion algorithm. Alternative absorption line of SO2F2 at 3619nm (2760cm-1) is relatively narrow, while its alternative absorption line at 6623nm (1503cm-1) is relatively wide. Therefore, the photo-acoustic spectroscopy is suitable for detecting SO2F2 at 6623nm (1503cm-1) and 7463nm (1340cm-1). The SO2F2 optical gas absorption cell and the charged detection device of mid infrared laser spectrum are developed, and the field adaptability of the charged detection device and the pilot application of charged detection are studied.

Author Keywords: field adaptability of charged detection device

articleTitle: Study on Flight Landing Time Prediction in Complex Terminal Areas
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: The impact of control deployment, and complex airport terminal area flight landing time uncertainty is greater. One significant way to ease this situation is to predict the flight landing time accurately. However, in complex airport regions, flights are more susceptible to various factors, such as control factors and airspace factors. In this context, effectively predicting flight landing times becomes more difficult. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes to comprehensively consider various factors affecting the flight landing time in the complex terminal regions and use XGBoost regression algorithm to predict the flight landing time. Firstly, the variables affecting the landing time of flights in complex terminal areas are explained to determine the variables used in the experiment. Then input the data into the XGBoost regression model for training, take the remaining flight time of the flight as the target value, establish the flight arrival time prediction model, quickly realize the model training, and predict the expected arrival time of the flight in three different peak periods. It is found that the model has good control over fitting ability and high prediction accuracy; Finally, by comparing the prediction results using multiple variables with those using only longitude, latitude and height, it is verified that the prediction accuracy using multiple variables is higher.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Effect Factors of Long-term Interruption of Engineering Mathematics Learning--by the CAAC First Test Flight Training Course as an Example
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Taking 23 trainees in the first CAAC test flight training course as subjects, the effect factors of long-term interruption of engineering mathematics learning were analyzed. The result of the experiment reveal that the individual mathematics learning ability and mathematics foundation are positively correlated with mathematics achievement after long-term interruption. While interruption time and age have no significant effect on mathematics achievement. The research further analyzes the reasons leading to the experimental results and provides necessary theoretical support for the selection of CAAC test flight talents. At the same time, the research also provides some reference for talent selection and curriculum development in similar situations.

articleTitle: A Survey on Students' Satisfaction with College English IV Course in Blended Learning Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Blended learning which combines online learning with offline classroom learning aims to give full play to the advantages of online learning and traditional classroom teaching at the same time, to make up for the shortcomings of both, so as to improve students' learning effect and learning efficiency. In recent years, due to the impact of the epidemic and the development of sciences and technologies, the blended learning has been rapidly developed and studied in a wide range of educational fields. As an important indicator reflecting learning effect, student satisfaction has gradually attracted the attention of scholars at home and abroad. This study mainly explores the the overall satisfaction of College English students in the blended learning environment and the specific situation of the seven dimensions of self-efficacy, learning motivation, perceived ease of use of technology, perceived usefulness of technology, learning support, teaching ability and learning satisfaction. Besides, the gender differences in the level of learning satisfaction among College English students will also be researched. Then some suggestions are put forward to further improve the learning satisfaction of College English students, and some limitations and shortcomings are pointed out.

articleTitle: Effect of Video Game Training on Air Traffic Controller Cognitive Capability
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Cognitive capability is one of the most important personal characteristics of air traffic controllers and is also a signature component of their training. This quantitative research aims to explore whether video game training has a considerable effect on improving the cognitive capability of air traffic controllers. A sample of 30 students learning at Embry Riddle Aeronautical University, who were randomly assigned to the video game training group or conventional case training group. At the end of the experiment, participants completed five cognitive tests which are part of the Air Traffic Selection and Training. This study indicates that video game training has a more efficient and significant role in improving part of cognitive abilities of air traffic controllers.

articleTitle: Research on University-Industry Cooperation of Vocational Colleges under the Background of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: The characteristics of Artificial intelligence, such as intelligence, automation, personalization, diversification and collaboration, promote educational innovation. The essence of University-Industry cooperation is to promote the perfect integration of specialty setting and industry demand, teaching content and work practice, teaching process and work process, learning site and work place. To stimulate the efficiency release of all kinds of intelligent technology applied in the University-Industry integration of vocational education, effectively make use of the powerful resource integration ability of Artificial intelligence, empower the upgrading of the University-Industry integration system, create concrete, diversified and intelligent all kinds of new educational practice situations, and reconstruct the multi-dimensional ability of industry-education integration of vocational education.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Air Traffic Support Capability of Small and Medium Airport Based on Entropy and Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: The air traffic control support capability of the airport is the key link to ensure the normal operation of flights and airports. It is one of the core elements to promote the positive development of small and medium-sized airports. Therefore, by putting the air traffic control operation into consideration, the evaluation index of air traffic control assurance ability in small and medium-sized airports is constructed from four dimensions: safety management, running environment, personnel evaluation, facilities, and equipment. Based on determining a certain range of flights, the entropy weight-cloud model is used to evaluate the air traffic control support capability of small and medium-sized airports. The example shows that the method can evaluate the support capability of small and medium-sized airports scientifically and accurately, and it is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research on TCAS Warning Factors Between Transportation and Training Flights Using Monte-Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: In order to reduce the TCAS warning rate when the transport and training flights operate at the same airport, the TCAS warning factors of the transport and training flights during the final independent parallel approaching were studied. The working principle of the TCAS system is briefly introduced, and the aircraft conflict detection model is established. The motion model of transport and training aircraft during final independent parallel approaching is established, and the Monte Carlo method is used to generate a large number of initial parameters for flight simulation. The TCAS warning rate and the flight data of each waring are obtained through a large number of simulations. Using the control variable method, the factors that affect the TCAS warning rate, such as the speed difference, sensitivity level, lateral separation, and longitudinal separation between the two aircraft, are analyzed. The research results show that the warning rate is positively correlated with the speed difference and negatively correlated with the lateral separation. Most of the warnings occur at 4 sensitivity level. The increase of the longitudinal separation will cause the warning rate to increase first and then decrease, and the warning rate will peak when the transport aircraft is 875m behind the training aircraft.

articleTitle: Itinerary Card Anti-cheating Beyond OCR
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Since the COVID-19 pandemic, the itinerary card has become so pertinent to our lives that we need to show our itinerary card whether we take public transport or enter public places. The traditional way to manually check and record the information on the itinerary card is inefficient. It easily leads to congestion at the entrance, especially in high-traffic areas. In addition, some people even falsify their itinerary codes to evade mandatory testing or quarantine for COVID-19. Therefore, an efficient itinerary checking method is needed to alleviate the crowded problem, reduce cross-infection, and intelligently detect itinerary cheating. To address these issues, we propose a deep-learning-based method combined with OCR techniques. This method consists of five parts, including ROI locating, color classification, OCR, information pooling, and anti-cheating. The proposed scheme can extract the itinerary information on the itinerary card and check it. It also provides a certain anti-cheating function. Experimental results show that the proposed scheme can efficiently check the information on the itinerary card with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Task to Competency: From the Perspective of 13th Hour Aptitude Testing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Pilot initial licensing training is a critical stage in professionalism lifecycle management system and plays a key role in ensuring civil aviation safety. Traditional pilot initial licensing training is based on task- or hour-based training. In recent years, a new ideology of pilot training called competency-based training and assessment, is advocated to enhance pilots' risk management ability to resist the gray rhinoceroses and black swans. However, to the best of our knowledge, the development of competencies is difficult to carry out if lacking enough task - or hour-based training. Therefore, it is rather important to deeply investigate the relationship between competency-based training and assessment and traditional pilot training. In this context, we firstly introduce pilot training roadmap in China and then conduct an analysis on checklist data of FL9 from aptitude testing of 13th hour training. Finally, we try to figure out the interconnections between tasks and competencies, which will have great significance on further reformation of pilot training in China.

articleTitle: Redevelopment of Textbook Based on Blended Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Foreign authentic textbooks are frequently used in bi-lingual teaching when English is also utilized as the medium of instruction to teach academic subjects in China. Therefore, a systematic approach, blending traditional teaching with internet-based virtual learning, is required for textbooks redevelopment to meet the learners' needs and action research is an appropriate option to investigate and develop context-specific material. To illustrate how to adapt the textbook to meet the learners' needs, the researcher made an attempt by conducting action research in the early childhood education school, Tianhua College. The data was collected among the students from the Sino-US Early childhood education program and it was audio-recorded, transcribed, and transported into Nvivo version 11, for data management and coding. Findings showed that the students' academic, language and cultural needs can be addressed to a great extent when the redevelopment process is based on blended learning.

articleTitle: The Study on Quality Evaluation System of Graduate Education in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: This paper proposes to carry out the quality evaluation of graduate education based on big data technology and construct the quality evaluation index system of graduate education based on big data. It also proposes to use modern information technology to continuously collect and deeply analyze the relevant data in the graduate education system, intuitively present the state of graduate education, and provide objective basis for multi subject value judgment and scientific decision-making.

articleTitle: Abnormal Financial Big Data Based on Deep Neural Network Recognition Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Accurate identification of abnormal financial data is an important way for the normal operation of the financial system. The traditional detection method uses statistical method to verify. Although this method can intuitively and quickly screen out abnormal data, it can not deal with the current massive digital data. To solve the above problems, the traditional random forest model is modified and the variance term is added to enhance the effect of the model. At the same time, deep RNN network is used to train the data after random forest processing. The experimental results show that the proposed deep neural random forest model has good recognition performance, and can also effectively verify abnormal financial data.

articleTitle: Research on Pilot Control Ability of Drones in Medium and Large Branch Logistics
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: In recent years, logistics drones have developed rapidly, with large drones reflecting great advantages. As the development of large UAVs is not yet mature, the core competency system for UAV pilots is still a gap, so it is difficult to train large logistics UAV pilots. This study examines part of the core competencies of large UAV pilots, i.e. research on the quality of pilot training and evaluation models. It proposes flight scenarios for medium and large regional logistics UAVs, the necessary qualities of UAV pilots, methods for training large UAV pilots, studies the evaluation model for the quality of large UAV pilot talents, and formulates specific rules for the evaluation of large UAV pilot training. The results can provide a favourable basis for large UAV pilot training, and have practical application value and guidance significance for promoting the new development of civil aviation.

articleTitle: Core Competency Evaluation of Pilot Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Currently, on a global scale, civil aviation safety indicator data has improved significantly, and the total number of accidents, the total accident rate and the number of fatalities have decreased, but catastrophic accidents, especially accident symptom, still exist. In order to improve pilots' flight training skills and ensure flight safety, Evidence-Based Training (EBT) for Professionalism Life cycle Management System (PLM) is a necessary measure and an important method to ensure civil aviation safety. By introducing a combination of qualitative and quantitative methods, this paper uses the analytic hierarchy process to construct a judgment matrix for the affiliation of pilots' core competency, and determines the index weights of core competency. According to the weights of the three-level indicators and the two-level indicators determined by the judgment matrix, a comprehensive evaluation model of PLM oriented core competency is established. The example calculation shows that the evaluation model can comprehensively and effectively evaluate the core competency of pilots.

articleTitle: Research on Baggage Tray Recognition in Airports Based on Residual Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: In recent years, civil aviation industry of China has made extraordinary achievements, and since the reform and ope ning up, civil aviation industry of China has entered a new era of rapid development, and the airport construction has also been de veloped continuously. At present, the wisdom civil aviation progr am proposed by the state is being implemented gradually. Wisdo m civil aviation refers to the application of new generation techno logies such as artificial intelligence, Internet of Things, cloud com puting, etc. to the civil aviation industry, making travel and logist ics to digital transformation, but there is still a lack of further dev elopment. Due to the diversified, non-standardized and non-speci fied characteristics of checked baggage, trays are introduced as t he carrier of checked baggage and baggage handling system in ai rports, but there are problems such as difficulties in tray recover y and low efficiency. To address this problem, this paper propose s the use of ResNet network architecture to identify whether a pal let is used or not and facilitate the systematic handling of pallet re covery work. The algorithm model proposed in this paper can ac hieve 95.17% accuracy in the problem of intelligent recognition <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{0}$</tex> f whether a pallet is used or not, which verifies the effectiveness <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{0}$</tex> f the network model for this problem and provides a favorable help for the development of smart civil aviation.

articleTitle: Research on Application of SLAM in Appearance Inspection of Civil Aviation Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: In the normal operation process of civil aircraft, the inspection of aircraft surface and appearance is an indispensable link, which is a guarantee of airworthiness and safety in the normal operation of civil aircraft. At present, around the airplane visual inspection by maintenance personnel is still the main way of appearance inspection all over the world. This method has a series of problems, such as low efficiency and limited by the physiological conditions of inspectors. In this regard, seeking a reliable intelligent method to complete this task has become an important task of the intelligence of the current civil aviation industry. To solve this problem, this paper proposes to use simultaneous localization and mapping technology to provide navigation services for mobile platforms, and carry out aircraft appearance inspection tasks by moving the mobile devices equipped with sensors according to the inspection route around the aircraft. This paper uses orb-SLAM3 algorithm to experiment in the actual environment. The results show that this method can make the mobile platform build the environment map according to the trajectory, and lay the foundation for the autonomous navigation of the subsequent platform.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Flight Vision Simulation System Based on Flight Training Data and Flightgear
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: For the existing flight simulation system can not directly use the real flight training data, lack of multi-angle observation aircraft method and other problems, designed and implemented a set of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{B/S}$</tex> architecture based on the flight view restoration system. The system can adapt to different data formats among various aircraft types, pre-process the data effectively, combine with Flightgear flight simulation engine, use JavaScript scripting language for web dynamic interaction, and realize the observation of aircraft flight status from three angles: aircraft, instrument and flight trajectory. The system is tested with real flight training data, and the results show that the system can correctly restore the flight view and restore the animation clearly and smoothly. The system has the characteristics of high simulation, high fluency and high clarity, and has significant application prospects in the field of flight training quality assessment and flight accident investigation.

articleTitle: Fine Dining Restaurants and e-Business Development as a Development Strategy under Covid-19. The Case of Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants 2020–2021
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: This study seeks to explore whether enhancing the digital channel in fine dining restaurants turns out to be a development strategy under covid-19. Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants for the period 2020 and 2021 is selected as a case, because: (1) there are 50 restaurants belonging to the fine dining category and therefore possible to compare each other, (2) being an annual ranking, it is possible analyze the variation in their operations, after two years under covid-19, (3) all of them have an official website. The methodology consists of reviewing each of the 50 restaurants (both website and Instagram social network) for the period 2020 and 2021, based on predefined aspects. It is concluded that promoting the digital channel in fine dining restaurants turns out to be a development strategy under covid-19, as observed in restaurants in the 50 best rest ranking in 2020, which shows an increase in digitalization to satisfy a digital segment that previously was not being fully served.

articleTitle: Research on Dance Movement Evaluation Method Based on Deep Learning Posture Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: This study proposes a quantitative evaluation method of monocular video dance movements based on deep learning, and provides a scientific and quantitative dance movement evaluation system to help students and dance teachers quickly identify and judge their dance movement standards. In this paper, the neural network-based 3D human pose estimation method is used to realize the identification and collection of key points of video human pose and skeleton. Aiming at the problem that it is difficult for users to ensure the time consistency with the reference video in the actual video acquisition process, a video frame alignment method based on ant colony algorithm is proposed. Aiming at the problem of large coordinate displacement caused by the tester's height, fat and thinness, and different video shooting angles, the evaluation and analysis method of moving human body posture based on similarity matching between feature planes is used to solve the problem. The scores of the input movements, the user video and the benchmark video are output at the same time, and provided to dance learners, so that the students' “non-standard” dance movements can be identified in a timely and effective manner, and the evaluation results are fed back to the students in a friendly way, so that Students can correct dance movements in time to achieve better training results.

articleTitle: Research on Small Moving Object Detection Based on Improved Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: As it is difficult to detect small moving targets in wide field of view and long distance environment, this study uses the fluctuation of optical field intensity to enhance the characteristic signal of moving targets, and then combines the local Gaussian mixture model to segment the foreground of the image enhancement area. The detection of small moving targets in different long-distance and complex backgrounds is realized. The result indicates that: The detection algorithm in this study can effectively improve the detection rate of small motion with long distance, wide field of view and low signal-to-noise ratio. The detection rate of drones photographed at 200 meters, 400 meters and 700 meters was 82%.

Author Keywords: low signal-to-noise ratio small moving target

articleTitle: Design and Practice of a Flight Data Application System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Flight data can not only be applied to safety analysis, condition monitoring and model establishment, but also play a very important role in improving the effect of theory teaching and students' own ability. Based on flight simulation software and visual programming language, a flight data application system is developed in this paper. The system includes three modules: flight status monitoring, verification experiment and data customization. It can realize the objective evaluation of flight skills, the analysis and verification of flight data of theoretical knowledge, as well as the functions of classroom teaching demonstration and independent design experiment of teachers and students. It solves the current situation of insufficient application of simulated flight data in theoretical teaching and students' ability training. The teaching practice shows that the system can improve students' flight technology, deepen their understanding of abstract knowledge, stimulate their independent exploration ability, and assist teachers' classroom teaching, which has high application value.

articleTitle: Experimental Platform Design of Extracting and Analyzing Structural Features of Dorsal Hand Vein Infrared Image
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: In the course teaching of digital image processing, developing new experimental content and platforms is crucial to strengthen student's understanding of the corresponding theories or knowledge. In this paper, we designed and developed a friendly interactive experimental platform for extracting and analyzing structural features of near infrared dorsal hand vein (DHV) images, which is a critical step in DHV biometrics. When doing experiments on the platform, students only need to input the original images into the system. Then, a series of operations e.g. image preprocessing, region of interest (ROI) extracting, main vessel width measuring, crossing point number measuring and statistical analysis, etc, can be carried out conveniently. Students can understand intuitively the experimental content. The testing results demonstrated that the platform was a promising experimental tool with rich functions and easy operation.

articleTitle: Positive and Negative Influence Factors in Users' Willingness of Mobile Payment in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: This study intends to explore the relationship between positive and negative influence factors in users' willingness of mobile payment and their use intention and behavior. Based on the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology 2 (UTAUT2), this study increases two variables including perceived risk and mental accounting. In this study, 455 questionnaires were distributed to users using mobile payment in Taiwan, 427 of which were recovered, with a recovery rate of 93.8% and 413 were valid, with an effective recovery rate of 90.8%. The conclusion is as follows: social influence, facilitating conditions, and habit have a positive and significant impact on the behavioral intention of mobile payment; mental accounting has negative and significant impact on behavioral intention. Facilitating conditions, habit and behavioral intention have positive and significant impact on use behavior, i.e. impact on users' cognitive decision making.

Author Keywords: Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology 2

articleTitle: Research on Performance Analysis of Aero-engine Based on QAR Time Series Data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Flight record data is a typical type of time series data. Using data mining technology and artificial intelligence technology to analyze flight record data can assist relevant practitioners in timely maintenance. In flight record data, the trend of exhaust gas temperature (EGT) is an important parameter reflecting the change of aero-engine performance. Prediction of exhaust gas temperature by building an algorithmic prediction model, and then the difference between the predicted value and the measured value is analyzed to reflect the degree of aero-engine performance declined. This paper performs feature extraction and data cleaning on the flight data, and then establishes a prediction model. Finally, the LSTM algorithm is used to predict the multi-stage exhaust gas temperature, and compare with the actual data to calculate the root mean square error. The results show that the root mean square error increases from time, reflecting the trend of aero-engine recession. Provide a reference basis of maintenance as appropriate.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of the User Information Cocoon Effect of Short Video Platforms Based on Personalized Recommendation Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: In order to explore the factors influencing the cocoon effect of user information on short video platforms under personalized recommendation algorithm, and prevent the occurrence of user information narrowing and addictive behavior. From the perspective of information ecology, according to the short video platform information delivery process, constructed a short video user information cocoon effect influencing factor model. The model has studied the impact of the personalized recommendation on information cocoon through information filtering, information homogeneity, flow experience, value identification, and users' information interest. Based on this, the questionnaire was designed, and the research model was verified by empirical research. Research results show that personalized recommendations generally make users form an information cocoon effect. The user's information cocoon effect is positively affected by value recognition, flow experience, and information interest. The personalized recommendation has a strong positive effect on users' flow experience and information interest through information filtering and information homogeneity. It has reference significance for algorithm optimization of short video platform, reducing information cocoon effect and improving user experience.

articleTitle: Non-technical Competency Assessment for the Initial Flight Training Based on Instructor Measurement Data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Competency-based training is an innovative flight training project, which is derived from the evidence-based training in commercial aviation retraining. Initial flight training is the primary stage of the competencies raise for the flight trainees. Effective competency assessment is the key to the competency-based training implementation, especially for the non-technical competencies. In this paper, a non-technical competency evaluation model was designed based on the competency assessment model construction. To avoid the influence of individual subjective judgment and favoritism from the flight instructor evaluation, a new approach for non-technical competency evaluation was proposed combining the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation with analytical hierarchy process (AHP). A case study for the workload management competency evaluation that is one of the core competencies in flight training was given based on the actual flight instructors measurement data from the flight institution. The analysis of evaluation results shows that the proposed method is an effective combination of subjective and objective methods, and fits with the results of the subjective scoring by the instructors.

articleTitle: Overview of Application in Data Mining Techniques to QAR Data Ansys
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: To ensure flight safety, the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) requires commercial aircraft to be fitted with a Quick Access Recorder (QAR), which continuously records the aircraft's raw flight data and captures thousands of flight parameters. Currently there is limited awareness and application of QAR data. With the continuous development of data analysis technology, data mining methods have been applied to QAR data processing, providing strong support and guarantee for aviation safety. This paper introduces the basic theory of data mining, reviews the applications of data mining in civil aviation operational safety, flight status assessment and identification, and general aviation respectively based on the clustering results of the literature in the past 12 years, and finally summarises the current problems faced by QAR data mining and the future development direction.

articleTitle: A Review of Flight Delay Prediction Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: With the rapid increase of civil aviation transport volume, the problem of flight delays is still extremely serious. Effective prediction of flight delays will not only reduce the economic losses caused by airline delays, but also reduce the stay time and improve the traveling satisfaction of passengers. First of all, this paper describes the various time nodes of the complete flight operation process in detail. Next, it systematically expounds the reasons for the generation and propagation of flight delays, and puts forward two solutions, i.e. flight cancellation and aircraft swapping. Then, the main characteristics of flight delay prediction methods are summarized into three categories: traditional statistical analysis, modeling simulation and queuing theory, and machine learning methods. In addition, we analyze the principles and implementation processes of the representative method in detail, and compare their advantages and disadvantages. Finally, this paper proposes the future research direction of flight delay prediction methods.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Intelligent and All-factor Territorial Development Regulation Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: The Ministry of Natural Resources unifiedly exercises the responsibility of territorial development regulation of all national land, which is one of the core responsibilities of the Ministry of Natural Resources. The territorial development regulation model based on the national spatial database and the quality control architecture system can effectively support the construction of an intelligent and all-factor national spatial governance system and the improvement of national governance capacity. Using the spatial use control model, the five-layer software architecture system and the corresponding data standard specification and security system, the intelligent and all-factor spatial use control precision model and innovative workflow as the platform features, and the platform operation mode of “business-data-system” synergy to establish the national development zone audit It can realize the transformation of the original offline working methods and processes, solve the problems of complicated declaration procedures, low efficiency of approval and improper storage of historical data, improve the efficiency and level of approval in the national development zones, enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of intelligent use control analysis, and form a closed-loop system of “online declaration - intelligent checking - networking audit - online correction - information disclosure” which is a cross-network, full-process government service platform.

articleTitle: Identifying Enablers and Barriers to Achieving Business-IT Alignment Through Enterprise Architecture Practice
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Many organisations are engaged in Enterprise architecture (EA) practice to align business and technology requirements as they transition towards a desirable future state. Previous conceptual studies indicate that leveraging enablers and overcoming blockers within EA practice lead to improved business-IT alignment, resulting in improved services. However, there is a limited body of literature that offers empirical validation of each enabler and blocker in practice identified. Therefore, this study aims to investigate key EA practice enablers and blockers to achieving business-IT alignment experienced by architects. Based on the interviews with 19 architects from 13 organisations, our study revealed five key enablers, as well as five critical blockers relating to business strategy, organisational structures, business and IT relationship, data and information use, and technology. Our study findings offer important implications for research and practice in business improvement endeavours.

articleTitle: Application and Teaching Practice of Virtual Simulation Technology Based on Cognitive Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: On the one hand, it is beneficial for students to complete the internalization of knowledge by constructing a real learning environment and designing a reasonable human-computer interaction way to let students' body senses and actions participate in the process of mental cognition, so as to increase the meaningful interaction between human-computer (object) environment. On the other hand, currently immersive VR mostly belongs to the customization of application scenarios. Individual VR learning takes a long time, and VR independent devices are still unable to support students' centralized parallel learning. In particular, the cognitive laws of limited attention model, cognitive load and attention shift, embodied cognition and so on suggest that existing educators can carry out practical training after the teaching of system theory to strengthen the internalization of practical cognition through immersive application scenarios. As for the centralized class teaching, the combination of early theory (including case) explanation with course ideology and politics, teachers' own knowledge and experience, external output ability, and the diversity, expansion and flexibility of teaching methods and tools application still have advantages for students' systematic theoretical learning under the guidance of teachers. This paper takes the fire safety training of the warehouse management course combined with the VR intelligent warehouse practice training system as an example, the teaching practice is explored.

Author Keywords: VR intelligent warehousing practice training system

articleTitle: Research on the Training Mode of Computer Professionals Driven by the Professional Certification of Engineering Education and the Integration of Industry and Education
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Combining with enterprises and implementing the integration of industry and education has become a common practice in professional construction and talent training in many local undergraduate colleges. However, under the background of engineering education professional certification, how to effectively implement professional construction and high-quality talent training is a problem worthy of exploration. Starting from the systematicness of talent training, combined with the elements of engineering education certification and industry education integration, this paper puts forward the computer professional talent training mode driven by engineering education certification and industry education integration, and analyzes the specific implementation strategy and feasibility of the two driving together, so as to provide reference for computer professional talent training and professional construction in local colleges and universities.

articleTitle: ARCards: Marker-Based Augmented Reality Recognition for Business Cards
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) is an advanced technology that can improve human life. It provides the users an interactive experience where the real world objects are combined with the computer-generated virtual elements such as sound, video, graphics, GPS overlays and more. This paper surveys on the existing AR applications and also introduces ARCards which is an AR mobile application for business cards using marker-based recognition approach. ARCards is designed to enhance a person's insight view of reality. It changes the users' perception by analyzing and implementing a new way of business card sharing where additional features and functions are well equipped by recognizing the markers on the business card. This could deliver an invaluable experience through AR when introducing a person or a company detail. More valuable contents can be included and displayed as virtual digital information and this is hardly to be fitted into a normal business card. AR markers, are trained to identify as a trigger to output the visual components stored digitally in a database. The main camera in the scene is replaced by ARCamera from Vuforia Engine to recognize the feature markers on a business card and automatically revokes the digital contents from the database to be rendered on the phone scene. Extended tracking is enabled so the users are not required to always place the business card in front of the camera for constantly tracking. The functionalities are combined with the physical world and instantly offer realtime feedback to the users. Recognition process takes less than a second to identify the important features. With ARCards, one can easily stand out from others. ARCards also received 86.7% of users' full satisfaction.

articleTitle: Research on CNN-BiLSTM Flight Training Slope Prediction Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: Today's civil aviation flight training has a large demand and high safety requirements. In order to better study the issues about flight training safety, the aircraft slope in flight training is studied. Specifically speaking, a CNN-BiLSTM model based on the attention mechanism is proposed to predict the flight slope problem in flight training. The roll angle of flight in training data is the object of study. Firstly, the parameters with greater influence on the roll angle are selected by gray correlation analysis. Secondly, the time window technique is used to convert the time series prediction problem into a supervised learning problem, and the feature vectors are extracted by convolutional neural network, and the extracted feature vectors are input into the BiLSTM network based on the attention mechanism. Finally, the optimal parameters of the model are determined by grid search, and the roll angle in the training data of a training model is predicted experimentally and the generalization ability of the model in other attitudes of flight training is investigated. The results of experiments show that the prediction model has better performance, high accuracy, small error and good stability in the flight training slope prediction problem compared with the traditional RNN prediction model and LSTM prediction model.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis of the Hot Spots and Frontiers of Algorithmic Governance Research in China and Internationally
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Big Data Engineering and Education (BDEE)
abstract: To investigate the hotspots and frontier research in the field of algorithmic governance in China and internationally, this paper apply the literature data in CNKI and Web of Science from 2011 to 2021 as the research object. secondly, this research apply Gephi and Cite Space to cluster the core authors, research countries and research institutions in this field. Then, this article compare the situation at home and abroad, classify the hotspot clusters in this field according to the keyword clustering results, and finally analyze the research evolution in this field to draw the future research trends.
